## Details

<a id="river_steer_off_screen"></a>
### [`river_steer_off_screen`](../../../../src/ground/river_steer.asm#L6) `$4AE6`

*routine*

Sets the steer request $401e to the nearer screen edge: 2 (left) when the river column $4023 is below $21, else 3 (right). Returns C=0.

- **Called from:** [`map_airfield_rows`](airfield_rows.md#map_airfield_rows)
- **Reads:** [`river_column`](../data/variables.md#river_column)
- **Writes:** [`river_turn_request`](../data/variables.md#river_turn_request)

| Label | Address | Comment |
|---|---|---|

| <a id="river_steer_off_screen_store"></a>[`river_steer_off_screen_store`](../../../../src/ground/river_steer.asm#L18) | `$4AFC` |  |
| <a id="river_steer_off_screen_done"></a>[`river_steer_off_screen_done`](../../../../src/ground/river_steer.asm#L23) | `$4B01` | Returns C=1 and $401e = 1 (straight) when the river column $4023 is below 2 or at $4f or more (off the map row). |

<a id="river_request_straight"></a>
### [`river_request_straight`](../../../../src/ground/river_steer.asm#L29) `$4B08`

*routine*

Sets the steer request $401e to 1 (straight). Returns C=1 when the river runs straight now ($401b = 1). A is 1 on exit.

- **Called from:** [`place_building`](country_row.md#place_building), [`road_row`](road.md#road_row)
- **Reads:** [`river_dir`](../data/variables.md#river_dir)
- **Writes:** [`river_turn_request`](../data/variables.md#river_turn_request)
